title: C++: Async Stream (Simulated)
description: Simulate an asynchronous data stream using callbacks and a delayed processing pattern.

steps.title: Async Stream
steps.description: Create an AsyncStream class that takes a vector<int> and processes each element with a delay. Use a queue of callbacks. Implement subscribe(function<void(int)>) that is called for each element as it's processed.
hints: void push(int val) { tasks.push([this, val]() { for (auto& cb : subscribers) cb(val); }); }

verification.failureMessage: Process all 3 values through the stream
